parsed.note_markdown:
### FHN — Strategic repositioning obscures underlying profitability

**Reported GAAP diluted EPS was negative $0.20 versus positive $0.54 in 2Q26**, a $0.74 sequential decline. The reported loss available to common shareholders was $94 million [B0105, B0109]. However, **adjusted EPS was $0.53**, down only $0.01 sequentially, after excluding $0.73 per share of adverse notable items [B0148, B0022].

**EPS drivers:** The most significant unusual item was a $473 million pre-tax loss associated with the pending mortgage-loan sale, partially offset by a $45 million related provision reversal. Additional restructuring and other expenses contributed to the adjustment [B0160–B0165].

**Revenue and margin:** GAAP NII increased $7 million to $683 million. FTE NIM slipped 1 basis point to 3.48%. Reported noninterest income was negative $276 million because of the repositioning, whereas adjusted noninterest income was $197 million. Noninterest expense declined to $529 million from $531 million [B0073, B0200, B0084, B0131, B0096].

**Credit:** The reported provision was a $25 million benefit; net charge-offs totaled $36 million and ACL coverage reached 1.25% [B0098, B0443, B0211].

**Capital and returns:** CET1 declined to 10.3%, while reported ROTCE was negative 5.33%. Adjusted ROTCE was 14.36%, and tangible book value was $13.84 per share [B0213, B0204, B0205, B0223].

**Guidance:** Management indicated revenue growth near the low end of its previously communicated 3%–7% adjusted range, with approximately flat adjusted expenses [B0800].

**Investment thesis:** Mixed. Core earnings remained relatively stable, but the repositioning meaningfully affected reported capital and book value. Execution and subsequent margin benefits are critical.
